source_origin.work: Oliver Byrne, The First Six Books of the Elements of Euclid (London: William Pickering, 1847)
source_origin.page: DjVu page 45, rendered by Wikimedia at 1920 px wide

checked: Every word and inline symbol placed at its measured scan position; registration checked by overlaying the rebuilt page on the scan at 1920 px.
Figure geometry (apex, base vertices, foot, 148 px angle radius, dotted extensions) matched against colour-segmented scan components.
Text extraction reads in order with word spaces.
Structural audit: 0 issues, 0 warnings; both fonts embedded (review/audit.json).
editorial_decisions: Long s (ſ) modernised to s: the open Caslon face has no ſ, and modern spelling keeps 'straight', 'shall', 'construct' and 'const.' searchable.
The c-t ligature in 'construct' and the old-style figures are set as ordinary letters and lining figures.
Inks white-balanced against the paper colour (239, 235, 210) rather than copied from the yellowed scan.
raster_regions: Engraved initial F, kept as a cleaned crop of scan region (64, 460)-(290, 712): rebuilt/figures/initial-F.png.
not_text: ∴ and ⊥ are drawn as vector shapes because the text face lacks them, so they are not searchable.
